verdict.rationale: Paddle's MCP server exposes a codemode interface (search/execute) that can chain arbitrary Paddle API calls — creating a product, price, and checkout link — within a single agent session, backed by API key/OAuth auth, sandbox testing, and skills describing catalog setup and checkout flows. This directly supports an agent provisioning product+price+payment link in one session via API/MCP. missing for 10: no independent hands-on transcript of an agent actually completing this exact end-to-end task (create product, price, and link) in one session, only vendor docs and probes confirming the server/tools exist.
